objective: Meet the owner's symmetric +/-20% human-mesh vertex rule and materially align editable edge flow and inner point placement with the exact source attachment for beard and house.

priorAttempts.reason: 0.58 approval probability and 0.72 DoD despite count match and 0.86 topology support; quantitative interior alignment and structural evidence were insufficient

inScope: Original Spine 4.0.64 same-skin/slot/attachment UV, hull and triangles supply matched artist count and a dimensionless cross-section profile; dimensions must match the source PNG.

Deterministic geometry recomputes contour and opaque cross-section coordinates from the current PNG; only artist hull/interior counts, normalized three band levels and lateral span ratios guide topology density and placement.
Independent +/-20% per-attachment hard precheck before Jev plus separate <=2% foreground loss and transparent addition, with topology comparison and Tail regression.
outOfScope: Bones, weights, deformation, head deform, Spine mesh serialization, artist-coordinate copying, production-art acceptance, private images or source skeletons in Git
implementationSummary: The previous revision distributed six house interior points at generic equally spaced rows and one-third/two-thirds width fractions, which produced a symmetric artist-to-generated nearest interior distance of 43.93 raster pixels. The revised tool extracts three dimensionless (row fraction, lateral span fraction) bands from the human six inner points: (0.31198, 0.86878), (0.48140, 0.63987), (0.79959, 0.61233). The engine samples filled rows at those fractions and places each lateral pair relative to that row's currently opaque span. The exact artist XY values and edges are not copied. The matched house result is 25 vertices, 19 hull, six interior, 29 triangles, with symmetric mean nearest interior distance 2.8183 pixels and hull distance 5.3380 pixels. Beard remains boundary only like artist (24/24, 22 triangles), with symmetric mean nearest hull distance 2.8238 pixels. A source profile is optional; no profile retains the previously validated starter path. Reference metadata is validated, and a missed +/-20% budget emits a diagnostic warning. The exact matched case result is checked again by the hard precheck before Jev.
humanDecision: The owner explicitly chose +/-20% relative to the same original artist mesh as a non-negotiable per-case vertex count rule; point count alone remains insufficient.

checks.name: Matched source provenance
checks.evidence: Both source .spine projects were exported directly with Spine 4.0.64. The reference tool resolves exact named skin/slot/attachment, checks image width/height, parses true UV/hull/triangle arrays and derives only counts and dimensionless band ratios for generation. Private .spine/JSON/PNG, generated meshes and coordinate overlays remain outside Git. Beard PNG SHA256 81BEA8EDACA7192A42A74BE6306A96B70CC3A8E581ADAD2B2FAD7693CEFA4DF6, house B6390F98F2ED123F61071DD35D42764CFCB497E73AC9BC0F19D3F7EC6112BF07.

checks.name: Mandatory counts and distribution
checks.evidence: Beard: artist and generated both 24 total / 24 hull / 0 interior / 22 triangles. House: artist and generated both 25 total / 19 hull / six interior / 29 triangles. All individual signed deviations are exactly 0%, well inside the owner's +/-20% range. Points are determined by raster corners and filled reference-profile cross sections, not inserted solely to pad counts. A synthetic case with profile and 100 repeats exercises the same path. Prior house 11/25 and missing reference cases fail the local hard gate before Jev SDK load.

checks.name: Measured topology proximity
checks.evidence: Independent symmetric nearest-neighbor comparison in pixel space: house interior 43.9309 px before profile to 2.8183 px with profile; house hull 5.3380 px; beard hull 2.8238 px. Exact-coordinate artist/old/new visual overlays were inspected: house inner controls now sit at the artist's upper cornice, mid-body, and lower plinth levels with similar lateral spread; beard is boundary-only like artist. These are vertex-position proximity metrics, not identical edges or animation proof. Beard has four skinny triangles (<10 degrees) versus artist zero; house five versus artist twelve. These limitations are in diagnostics.

checks.name: Raster, topology and regression
checks.evidence: Beard 882 corrected foreground cells: 16 missed (1.8141%) and 16 background added (1.8141%); house 51,606: 112 missed (0.2170%), 423 added (0.8197%), with 17 detached alpha cells removed under the same explicit 0.5% cleanup. Independent MeshSpec topology validator passes both. Tail retains 24 vertices / 27 triangles, 1297 missed / 306 added of 81,641 foreground and zero triangles <10 degrees, exactly the Gate 3.1 static baseline. Each private case was byte identical over 100 full generations.

checks.name: Full repository verification
checks.evidence: npm run verify passes Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript build/check and 48 tests across seven files. Portable tests include a nonuniform reference band profile, deterministic 100-run output, invalid metadata rejection and all prior Gate golden/topology/CLI regressions. git diff --check passes.

definitionOfDone.evidence: Beard 24/24 and house 25/25; hard local precheck mandatory.

definitionOfDone.evidence: Hull/interior split and triangles exactly match; artist-profile bands move house interior nearest mean to 2.82 px from 43.93 px; beard all vertices are boundary points like artist. Edge and angle differences are disclosed; no exact duplicate claim.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Each separate alpha error <=2% and legal deterministic topology
definitionOfDone.evidence: Both categories below 2%, independent validator and three real 100-run checks.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Prior gates and Tail baseline preserved
definitionOfDone.evidence: 48 tests passing; Tail metrics exactly retained.

knownLimitations: The profile requires an artist mesh exported from the same attachment; other/new images without one remain starter meshes needing human review.
Even close vertex locations do not establish identical triangle connectivity or animated deformation quality. Beard retains four narrow triangles.
All user artwork and original .spine projects stay private, and the reference analysis is not a trained universal model.
